root.label: Alleged rape of LSU student by Damien Shanklin

events.label: Alleged rape of LSU student by Damien Shanklin

slots.name: contact duration
slots.sentence: Citing Title IX documents, ESPN reported Shanklin and the woman agreed their initial contact inside Shanklin's residence hall room was consensual, but he had penetrative sex with her without her consent for nearly 20 seconds before she told him to stop.

slots.name: alleged payment
slots.sentence: She went to a nearby hospital to get a rape kit and alleges he sent her $1,000 so she wouldn't press charges, and that Shanklin's mother contacted her to ask her the same.

slots.name: incident date
slots.sentence: A police report was filed by a woman who said defensive end Damien Shanklin raped her in October 2025.
